a(n) = |{0 < k < n: L(k) + q(n-k) is prime}|, where L(k) is the k-th Lucas number (A000204), and q(.) is the strict partition function (A000009).

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 3, s(2*n-1) = 6. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-2), where T is defined in A026022.

a(n) = number of (s(0), s(1), ..., s(2*n-1)) such that s(i) is a nonnegative integer and |s(i) - s(i-1)| = 1 for i = 1,2,...,n, s(0) = 2, s(2*n-1) = 5. Also a(n) = T(2*n-1,n-2), where T is the array defined in A026009.
